f-a11y.1.evidence: Guest /community/: first Tab = "Skip to content" (#content), 2nd "forums"; Enter moves to #content and next Tab lands on "Community" inside main (focus stays on BODY itself, sequential start point moves).

f-a11y.2.evidence: bob, 40 Tab stops on a Feature Requests topic in light mode: all stops show outline or box-shadow ring except one INPUT. NOT PERFORMED: dark mode ring check, header and space listing walk, and a strict reading-order comparison.

f-a11y.3.evidence: 99 visible icon-only buttons on a topic all have aria-label/title; vote/bookmark/emoji toggles carry aria-pressed/aria-expanded. FAIL: Share button has no aria-expanded or aria-haspopup. Anonymous toggle, composer toolbar and notification bell states not individually verified.

f-a11y.4.evidence: Reply editor is role=textbox aria-multiline=true aria-label "Reply editor". NOT PERFORMED: topic title input label and poll option "Option 1" labels.

f-a11y.5.evidence: Vote cluster is role=group "Vote on this reply" with buttons "Vote up/Vote down" and aria-pressed. Reaction controls expose only "React", "Like", "Love"; no "Like, N reactions, you reacted" label found; score announcement not verified.

f-a11y.6.evidence: bob, Report on a reply: role=dialog aria-modal=true aria-labelledby=jt-report-title, radiogroup of 5 reasons labelled by the title, focus on first radio, 14 Tabs stay inside the dialog, Escape closes it and focus returns to the Report button.

f-a11y.7.evidence: NOT PERFORMED: /community/mod/ queue had no items for test_moderator, so approve/remove/spam/ban/close buttons were not available; no alert() calls found in page scripts.

f-a11y.8.evidence: Share opened with Enter; arrow keys moved focus to a BUTTON and Escape returned focus to Share, but the trigger exposes no aria-expanded state. NOT PERFORMED: user menu and notification panel keyboard behaviour.

f-a11y.9.evidence: NOT PERFORMED reliably: scripted contrast sampling gave 2.26:1 for .jt-pill/.jt-tag text but backgrounds are partly translucent/inherited, so the figure is indicative only; dark mode contrast not measured.

f-a11y.10.evidence: 390px topic page: no horizontal overflow, font-size control present (A / A+ / A++). FAIL: 132 interactive elements smaller than 40px (font-size buttons 30x30, theme toggle 32x32, inline author/breadcrumb links 17-22px high). 200% zoom NOT PERFORMED.

f-a11y.11.evidence: aria-live/status/alert regions exist (polite, assertive, status, alert) on the topic page. NOT PERFORMED: toast announcement and aria-describedby linkage of form errors to fields.

f-a11y.12.evidence: finn (silenced) on a topic: no editor rendered, visible text "Your account is currently silenced and cannot post." present in DOM (element has no role=alert/status). Banned member message not separately walked.

f-a11y.13.evidence: Topic page has exactly one h1 and heading levels 1,2,3,3,4... with no skipped level; breadcrumb is a nav labelled "Breadcrumb". FAIL: no aria-current="page" on the current crumb. Profile page headings not checked.
